messages.plan-empty: {{class}} has no subjects in its plan.
messages.plan-exceeds-template: {{class}} needs {{needed}} a week, but its template has only {{available}}.
messages.per-day-unbuildable: {{class}}: {{item}} needs {{minutes}} on {{days}}, which the periods that day cannot add up to.
messages.no-qualified-teacher: No teacher with Grade {{grade}} in their grades teaches {{subject}} ({{classes}}).
messages.no-specialist: {{subject}} needs a teacher other than the class teacher ({{classes}}).
messages.class-teacher-no-daily-subject: {{teacher}}, class teacher of {{class}}, must teach a subject here with at least 5 periods a week (so they can take the first period every day).
messages.class-teacher-wrong-grade: {{teacher}} is class teacher of {{class}} but is not assigned to grade {{grade}}.
messages.capacity-short: {{subject}} needs {{needed}} periods a week, but teachers can cover only {{capacity}}.
messages.min-per-week-unreachable: Teachers' minimum weekly lessons add up to {{needed}}, but only {{available}} lessons are planned.
